use crate::{runtime, support::*};
use nix::{
    libc,
    sys::signal::{Signal, kill},
    unistd::Pid,
};
use runtime::test_support::{self as hooks, Checkpoint, SignalTarget, TerminalRequest};
use runtime::{App, Invocation};
use std::{
    io::{self, Write},
    path::PathBuf,
    sync::{
        Arc, Mutex,
        atomic::{AtomicUsize, Ordering},
    },
    time::Duration,
};

async fn launch(id: &str) {
    let c = Controller::new();
    let p = Arc::new(Probe::default());
    let (r, _, _) = runtime(p.clone());
    let a = app(&r);
    child("A", "gate", b"A\n", b"", 0);
    if id == "P1-RUN-07" {
        child("A", "inherit", b"inherit-ok", b"", 0);
        env("P1_EXPECT_CWD", std::env::current_dir().unwrap());
        env("P1_SENTINEL", "sentinel-雪")
    }
    if id == "P1-RUN-05" {
        env("P1_READYFILE", c.dir.join("later-action"))
    }
    if id == "P1-RUN-09" {
        a.build().unwrap();
        assert!(a.error().unwrap().is_none());
        assert!(p.invocations.lock().unwrap().is_empty());
        p.once(0);
        r.shutdown().await.unwrap();
        return;
    }
    if id == "P1-RUN-10" || id == "P1-RUN-11" {
        a.build().unwrap()
    }
    a.run().unwrap();
    if id == "P1-RUN-05" {
        std::fs::write(c.dir.join("later-action"), b"").unwrap()
    }
    let peer = c.ready(&["A"]).remove(0);
    assert_ne!(peer.pid, std::process::id() as i32);
    assert_eq!(peer.ppid, std::process::id() as i32);
    if id == "P1-RUN-14" {
        for n in 0..4 {
            child("B", "exit", n.to_string().as_bytes(), b"", 0);
            let b = app(&r);
            b.run().unwrap();
            c.ready(&["B"]);
            join(&b).await;
            c.alive(&peer)
        }
    }
    if id != "P1-RUN-07" {
        c.alive(&peer);
        c.release(&peer)
    }
    let i = join(&a).await;
    result(
        &i,
        if id == "P1-RUN-07" {
            b"inherit-ok"
        } else {
            b"A\n"
        },
        b"",
        0,
    );
    c.stopped(&peer);
    p.once(if id == "P1-RUN-14" { 5 } else { 1 });
    r.shutdown().await.unwrap();
}
async fn overlap(id: &str) {
    let c = Controller::new();
    let p = Arc::new(Probe::default());
    let (r, out, _) = runtime(p.clone());
    let a = app(&r);
    let b = app(&r);
    assert!(!Arc::ptr_eq(&a, &b));
    child("A", "gate", b"A\n", b"", 0);
    a.run().unwrap();
    child("B", "gate", b"B\n", b"", 0);
    b.run().unwrap();
    let peers = c.ready(&["A", "B"]);
    assert_ne!(peers[0].pid, peers[1].pid);
    for v in &peers {
        c.alive(v)
    }
    let reverse = id == "P1-RUN-04";
    let (first, last) = if reverse { (0, 1) } else { (1, 0) };
    c.release(&peers[first]);
    finalized(&p.at(first)).await;
    assert!(p.at(last).snapshot().is_none());
    assert!(out.get().is_empty(), "captured output leaked before Show");
    c.release(&peers[last]);
    for a in if reverse { [b, a] } else { [a, b] } {
        join(&a).await;
        r.show(&a.output().unwrap()).await.unwrap()
    }
    assert_eq!(out.get(), if reverse { b"B\nA\n" } else { b"A\nB\n" });
    p.once(2);
    r.shutdown().await.unwrap();
}
async fn pending() {
    let c = Controller::new();
    let p = Arc::new(Probe::default());
    let (r, _, _) = runtime(p.clone());
    let a = app(&r);
    child("A", "gate", b"complete-payload", b"", 0);
    a.run().unwrap();
    let peer = c.ready(&["A"]).remove(0);
    let observer = a.clone();
    let task = tokio::spawn(async move { observer.wait().await.unwrap() });
    assert!(p.last().snapshot().is_none());
    c.release(&peer);
    let i = task.await.unwrap();
    result(&i, b"complete-payload", b"", 0);
    assert!(i.claim_continuation().unwrap());
    i.finish_continuation();
    c.stopped(&peer);
    p.once(1);
    r.shutdown().await.unwrap();
}
async fn cached(id: &str) {
    let c = Controller::new();
    let p = Arc::new(Probe::default());
    let (r, _, _) = runtime(p.clone());
    let a = app(&r);
    let code = if id == "P1-AWAIT-04" { 7 } else { 0 };
    let err = if code == 7 {
        b"details\n".as_slice()
    } else {
        b""
    };
    child("A", "exit", b"partial\n", err, code);
    a.run().unwrap();
    c.ready(&["A"]);
    if id == "P1-AWAIT-02" || id == "P1-RESULT-10" {
        finalized(&p.last()).await;
        assert_eq!(&*a.output().unwrap(), b"partial\n")
    }
    let first = a.wait().await.unwrap();
    assert!(first.claim_continuation().unwrap());
    if id == "P1-AWAIT-17" {
        let again = a.wait().await.unwrap();
        assert!(Arc::ptr_eq(&first, &again));
        assert!(!again.claim_continuation().unwrap())
    }
    first.finish_continuation();
    let alias = a.clone();
    let second = alias.wait().await.unwrap();
    assert!(Arc::ptr_eq(&first, &second));
    assert!(!second.claim_continuation().unwrap());
    result(&first, b"partial\n", err, code);
    p.once(1);
    r.shutdown().await.unwrap();
}
async fn failed_launch(id: &str) {
    let p = Arc::new(Probe::default());
    let (r, _, _) = runtime(p.clone());
    let a = r.app("companion/absent");
    if id == "P1-RESULT-16" {
        a.build().unwrap();
        assert!(a.error().unwrap().is_some())
    }
    a.run().unwrap();
    let i = join(&a).await;
    result(&i, b"", b"", -1);
    assert!(
        errno(&a.error().unwrap().unwrap(), libc::ENOENT),
        "missing path cause lost"
    );
    assert!(Arc::ptr_eq(&a.wait().await.unwrap(), &i));
    assert!(!i.claim_continuation().unwrap());
    p.once(0);
    r.shutdown().await.unwrap();
}
async fn rerun(id: &str) {
    let c = Controller::new();
    let p = Arc::new(Probe::default());
    let (r, _, _) = runtime(p.clone());
    let a = app(&r);
    let mut previous: Option<Arc<Invocation>> = None;
    let mut saved = None;
    for n in 0..3 {
        let code = if (id == "P1-AWAIT-14" || id == "P1-RESULT-11") && n != 1 {
            7
        } else {
            0
        };
        let out = format!("attempt:{n}\0");
        let err = format!("stderr:{n}\n");
        child("A", "exit", out.as_bytes(), err.as_bytes(), code);
        a.run().unwrap();
        c.ready(&["A"]);
        let i = join(&a).await;
        result(&i, out.as_bytes(), err.as_bytes(), code);
        if let (Some(old), Some(s)) = (&previous, &saved) {
            assert!(!Arc::ptr_eq(old, &i));
            let old_s: runtime::Snapshot = old.snapshot().unwrap();
            let s: &runtime::Snapshot = s;
            assert!(Arc::ptr_eq(&old_s.stdout, &s.stdout));
            assert!(Arc::ptr_eq(&old_s.stderr, &s.stderr));
            assert_eq!(old_s.status, s.status);
            assert_eq!(
                old_s.error.as_ref().map(ToString::to_string),
                s.error.as_ref().map(ToString::to_string)
            )
        }
        saved = i.snapshot();
        previous = Some(i)
    }
    p.once(3);
    r.shutdown().await.unwrap();
}
async fn concurrent() {
    let c = Controller::new();
    let p = Arc::new(Probe::default());
    let (r, _, _) = runtime(p.clone());
    let a = app(&r);
    child("A", "gate", b"shared-result", b"", 0);
    a.run().unwrap();
    let v = c.ready(&["A"]).remove(0);
    let mut tasks = Vec::new();
    for _ in 0..16 {
        let a = a.clone();
        tasks.push(tokio::spawn(async move {
            let i = a.wait().await.unwrap();
            let claim = i.claim_continuation().unwrap();
            if claim {
                i.finish_continuation()
            }
            (i, claim)
        }))
    }
    c.release(&v);
    let mut claims = 0;
    for task in tasks {
        let (i, claim) = task.await.unwrap();
        claims += usize::from(claim);
        assert!(Arc::ptr_eq(&i, &p.last()));
        result(&i, b"shared-result", b"", 0)
    }
    assert_eq!(claims, 1);
    p.once(1);
    r.shutdown().await.unwrap();
}
async fn stopped(id: &str) {
    let c = Controller::new();
    let p = Arc::new(Probe::default());
    let (r, _, _) = runtime(p.clone());
    let a = app(&r);
    let mode = match id {
        "P1-STOP-10" => "descendant",
        "P1-STOP-11" => "descendant-closed",
        "P1-STOP-12" => "descendant-exit",
        _ => "gate",
    };
    let prefix = "first\n\n雪\t".as_bytes();
    child("A", mode, b"", b"warn\n", 0);
    env("P1_PREFIX_HEX", hex(prefix));
    a.run().unwrap();
    let labels = if mode.starts_with("descendant") {
        vec!["A", "A.child"]
    } else {
        vec!["A"]
    };
    let peers = c.ready(&labels);
    let mut other = None;
    if id == "P1-STOP-02" {
        child("B", "gate", b"B untouched", b"", 0);
        let b = app(&r);
        b.run().unwrap();
        other = Some((b, c.ready(&["B"]).remove(0)))
    }
    if id == "P1-STOP-13" {
        *p.signal_hook.lock().unwrap() = Some(Arc::new(|_, _| {
            Err(io::Error::from_raw_os_error(libc::EACCES))
        }))
    }
    let waiter = if id == "P1-STOP-16" {
        let alias = a.clone();
        Some(tokio::spawn(async move { alias.wait().await.unwrap() }))
    } else {
        None
    };
    if id != "P1-STOP-12" {
        let alias = a.clone();
        alias.stop().await.unwrap()
    }
    if id == "P1-STOP-03" {
        a.stop().await.unwrap()
    }
    if id == "P1-STOP-13" {
        assert!(errno(&a.error().unwrap().unwrap(), libc::EACCES));
        assert!(p.last().snapshot().is_none());
        c.alive(&peers[0]);
        *p.signal_hook.lock().unwrap() = None;
        c.release(&peers[0])
    }
    let i = join(&a).await;
    if let Some(task) = waiter {
        assert!(Arc::ptr_eq(&i, &task.await.unwrap()))
    }
    let s = i.snapshot().unwrap();
    assert_eq!(&*s.stdout, prefix);
    assert_eq!(&*s.stderr, b"warn\n");
    if id == "P1-STOP-13" {
        assert!(s.error.is_none());
        assert!(a.error().unwrap().is_none())
    } else if id != "P1-STOP-12" {
        assert!(s.error.is_some());
        assert_eq!(s.status, Some(128 + libc::SIGKILL))
    } else {
        assert_eq!(s.status, Some(0));
        if let Some(e) = s.error {
            assert!(
                e.to_string().contains("pipe"),
                "unexpected natural-exit error {e}"
            )
        }
    }
    for peer in &peers {
        c.stopped(peer)
    }
    if id == "P1-STOP-03" {
        a.stop().await.unwrap();
        assert!(Arc::ptr_eq(&a.wait().await.unwrap(), &i));
        assert_eq!(&*i.snapshot().unwrap().stdout, prefix)
    }
    let mut n = 1;
    if let Some((b, v)) = other {
        c.alive(&v);
        c.release(&v);
        result(&join(&b).await, b"B untouched", b"", 0);
        n += 1
    }
    if id == "P1-STOP-15" {
        child("A2", "exit", b"fresh", b"", 0);
        a.run().unwrap();
        c.ready(&["A2"]);
        let next = join(&a).await;
        assert!(!Arc::ptr_eq(&i, &next));
        result(&next, b"fresh", b"", 0);
        n += 1
    }
    p.once(n);
    r.shutdown().await.unwrap();
}
async fn stop_completed(id: &str) {
    let c = Controller::new();
    let p = Arc::new(Probe::default());
    let (r, _, _) = runtime(p.clone());
    let a = app(&r);
    let code = if id == "P1-STOP-06" { 7 } else { 0 };
    child("A", "exit", b"saved", b"details", code);
    a.run().unwrap();
    c.ready(&["A"]);
    let old = p.last();
    finalized(&old).await;
    let saved = old.snapshot().unwrap();
    a.stop().await.unwrap();
    let i = join(&a).await;
    assert!(Arc::ptr_eq(&old, &i));
    assert!(Arc::ptr_eq(&saved.stdout, &i.snapshot().unwrap().stdout));
    result(&i, b"saved", b"details", code);
    p.once(1);
    r.shutdown().await.unwrap();
}
async fn publication(id: &str) {
    let c = Controller::new();
    let p = Arc::new(Probe::default());
    let gate = Arc::new(Gate::default());
    let hold = gate.clone();
    *p.checkpoint_hook.lock().unwrap() = Some(Arc::new(move |e, _| {
        if e == Checkpoint::PrePublication {
            hold.hit()
        }
    }));
    let (r, _, _) = runtime(p.clone());
    let a = app(&r);
    child("A", "exit", b"natural", b"", 0);
    a.run().unwrap();
    c.ready(&["A"]);
    gate.observe();
    assert!(p.last().snapshot().is_none());
    if id == "P1-STOP-14" {
        *p.signal_hook.lock().unwrap() = Some(Arc::new(|_, _| {
            Err(io::Error::from_raw_os_error(libc::ESRCH))
        }))
    }
    a.stop().await.unwrap();
    gate.release();
    result(&join(&a).await, b"natural", b"", 0);
    p.once(1);
    r.shutdown().await.unwrap();
}
async fn stale_stop() {
    let c = Controller::new();
    let p = Arc::new(Probe::default());
    let gate = Arc::new(Gate::default());
    let hold = gate.clone();
    *p.checkpoint_hook.lock().unwrap() = Some(Arc::new(move |e, _| {
        if e == Checkpoint::CapturedStopTarget {
            hold.hit()
        }
    }));
    let (r, _, _) = runtime(p.clone());
    let a = app(&r);
    child("old", "gate", b"old", b"", 0);
    a.run().unwrap();
    let old = p.last();
    let peer = c.ready(&["old"]).remove(0);
    let alias = a.clone();
    let stopping = tokio::spawn(async move { alias.stop().await.unwrap() });
    gate.observe();
    c.release(&peer);
    join(&a).await;
    child("new", "gate", b"new", b"", 0);
    a.run().unwrap();
    let new = p.last();
    let peer = c.ready(&["new"]).remove(0);
    assert!(!Arc::ptr_eq(&old, &new));
    gate.release();
    stopping.await.unwrap();
    c.alive(&peer);
    assert!(new.snapshot().is_none());
    c.release(&peer);
    result(&join(&a).await, b"new", b"", 0);
    result(&old, b"old", b"", 0);
    p.once(2);
    r.shutdown().await.unwrap();
}
async fn stop_stress() {
    let c = Controller::new();
    let p = Arc::new(Probe::default());
    let (r, _, _) = runtime(p.clone());
    let a = app(&r);
    for n in 0..32 {
        child("A", "gate", b"tail", b"", 0);
        env("P1_PREFIX_HEX", hex(b"prefix"));
        a.run().unwrap();
        let peer = c.ready(&["A"]).remove(0);
        let alias = a.clone();
        let stopping = tokio::spawn(async move { alias.stop().await.unwrap() });
        c.release(&peer);
        stopping.await.unwrap();
        let i = join(&a).await;
        let s = i.snapshot().unwrap();
        assert!(&*s.stdout == b"prefix" || &*s.stdout == b"prefixtail");
        assert!(
            s.status == Some(0) || s.status == Some(137),
            "undefined outcome {}: {:?}",
            n,
            s
        );
        c.stopped(&peer)
    }
    p.once(32);
    r.shutdown().await.unwrap();
}
async fn capture(id: &str) {
    let c = Controller::new();
    let p = Arc::new(Probe::default());
    let gate = Arc::new(Gate::default());
    if id == "P1-RESULT-05" {
        *p.capture_gate.lock().unwrap() = Some(gate.clone())
    } else {
        p.capture_fault.store(true, Ordering::SeqCst)
    }
    let (r, _, _) = runtime(p.clone());
    let a = app(&r);
    child("A", "exit", b"abcdef", b"", 0);
    a.run().unwrap();
    c.ready(&["A"]);
    if id == "P1-RESULT-05" {
        gate.observe();
        assert!(p.last().snapshot().is_none());
        gate.release();
        result(&join(&a).await, b"abcdef", b"", 0)
    } else {
        let i = join(&a).await;
        let s = i.snapshot().unwrap();
        assert_eq!(&*s.stdout, b"abc");
        assert!(cause(&s.error.unwrap(), "injected-capture-error"))
    }
    p.once(1);
    r.shutdown().await.unwrap();
}
async fn raw_result(id: &str) {
    let c = Controller::new();
    let p = Arc::new(Probe::default());
    let (r, out, _) = runtime(p.clone());
    let a = app(&r);
    let (payload, err, mode) = match id {
        "P1-RESULT-02" => (Vec::new(), Vec::new(), "exit"),
        "P1-RESULT-03" => (b"\0\xff\xfe\r\n\"tail  ".to_vec(), Vec::new(), "exit"),
        "P1-RESULT-04" => (b"out\0".repeat(65536), b"err\n".repeat(65536), "large"),
        _ => (
            "first\n\nlast\t雪".as_bytes().to_vec(),
            b"notice\n".to_vec(),
            "exit",
        ),
    };
    if mode == "large" {
        child("A", mode, b"", b"", 0)
    } else {
        child("A", mode, &payload, &err, 0)
    }
    a.run().unwrap();
    c.ready(&["A"]);
    result(&join(&a).await, &payload, &err, 0);
    assert!(a.error().unwrap().is_none());
    r.show(&a.output().unwrap()).await.unwrap();
    assert_eq!(out.get(), payload);
    if id == "P1-RESULT-07" {
        child("B", "exit", b"", b"", 7);
        let b = app(&r);
        b.run().unwrap();
        c.ready(&["B"]);
        result(&join(&b).await, b"", b"", 7);
        assert!(b.error().unwrap().is_some());
        p.once(2)
    } else {
        p.once(1)
    }
    r.shutdown().await.unwrap();
}
async fn readiness(id: &str) {
    let c = Controller::new();
    let p = Arc::new(Probe::default());
    let (r, _, _) = runtime(p.clone());
    let (name, path) = private_companion();
    let original = std::fs::read(&path).unwrap();
    let a = r.app(name);
    match id {
        "P1-RESULT-13" => {
            a.build().unwrap();
            *p.remove_before_start.lock().unwrap() = Some(path.clone());
            a.run().unwrap();
            let i = join(&a).await;
            result(&i, b"", b"", -1);
            assert!(errno(&i.snapshot().unwrap().error.unwrap(), libc::ENOENT));
            assert_eq!(p.starts.load(Ordering::SeqCst), 1);
            assert_eq!(p.waits.load(Ordering::SeqCst), 0)
        }
        "P1-RESULT-15" => {
            std::fs::write(&path, b"not a native executable").unwrap();
            a.run().unwrap();
            let i = join(&a).await;
            result(&i, b"", b"", -1);
            assert!(errno(&i.snapshot().unwrap().error.unwrap(), libc::ENOEXEC));
            assert_eq!(p.waits.load(Ordering::SeqCst), 0)
        }
        "P1-RESULT-22" => {
            std::fs::remove_file(&path).unwrap();
            a.build().unwrap();
            assert!(a.error().unwrap().is_some());
            std::fs::write(&path, &original).unwrap();
            use std::os::unix::fs::PermissionsExt;
            std::fs::set_permissions(&path, std::fs::Permissions::from_mode(0o700)).unwrap();
            child("A", "exit", b"revalidated", b"", 0);
            a.run().unwrap();
            c.ready(&["A"]);
            result(&join(&a).await, b"revalidated", b"", 0);
            p.once(1)
        }
        "P1-RESULT-17" => {
            child("A", "exit", b"retained", b"", 0);
            a.run().unwrap();
            c.ready(&["A"]);
            let i = join(&a).await;
            std::fs::remove_file(&path).unwrap();
            a.build().unwrap();
            assert!(a.error().unwrap().is_some());
            result(&i, b"retained", b"", 0);
            assert!(Arc::ptr_eq(&a.wait().await.unwrap(), &i));
            assert!(a.error().unwrap().is_none());
            p.once(1)
        }
        _ => panic!("unexpected readiness case {id}"),
    };
    r.shutdown().await.unwrap();
    let _ = std::fs::remove_file(path);
}
async fn invalid_companion() {
    use std::os::unix::fs::{PermissionsExt, symlink};
    let p = Arc::new(Probe::default());
    let (r, _, _) = runtime(p.clone());
    let (name, path) = private_companion();
    let root = path.parent().unwrap();
    std::fs::set_permissions(&path, std::fs::Permissions::from_mode(0o600)).unwrap();
    let link = root.join(format!("link-{}", std::process::id()));
    symlink(&path, &link).unwrap();
    for name in [
        "../escape".to_owned(),
        "/absolute".to_owned(),
        "companion".to_owned(),
        name,
        format!("companion/{}", link.file_name().unwrap().to_str().unwrap()),
    ] {
        let a = r.app(name);
        a.run().unwrap();
        result(&join(&a).await, b"", b"", -1)
    }
    p.once(0);
    r.shutdown().await.unwrap();
    std::fs::remove_file(link).unwrap();
    std::fs::remove_file(path).unwrap();
}
async fn continuations(id: &str) {
    let c = Controller::new();
    let p = Arc::new(Probe::default());
    let (r, out, _) = runtime(p.clone());
    let a = app(&r);
    child("A", "exit", b"value", b"", 0);
    a.run().unwrap();
    c.ready(&["A"]);
    finalized(&p.last()).await;
    r.show(b"between|").await.unwrap();
    if id == "P1-CONT-09" {
        r.shutdown().await.unwrap();
        assert_eq!(out.get(), b"between|");
        p.once(1);
        return;
    }
    let first = a.wait().await.unwrap();
    assert!(first.claim_continuation().unwrap());
    if id == "P1-CONT-08" {
        let b = app(&r);
        child("B", "exit", b"B", b"", 0);
        b.run().unwrap();
        c.ready(&["B"]);
        let j = b.wait().await.unwrap();
        assert!(j.claim_continuation().unwrap());
        r.show(b"C:B|").await.unwrap();
        j.finish_continuation();
        r.show(b"A:end|").await.unwrap();
        first.finish_continuation();
        assert_eq!(out.get(), b"between|C:B|A:end|");
        p.once(2)
    } else {
        r.show(b"C:A|").await.unwrap();
        first.finish_continuation();
        let again = a.wait().await.unwrap();
        assert!(Arc::ptr_eq(&first, &again));
        assert!(!again.claim_continuation().unwrap());
        r.show(b"after|").await.unwrap();
        assert_eq!(out.get(), b"between|C:A|after|");
        if id == "P1-CONT-11" {
            child("A2", "exit", b"next", b"", 0);
            a.run().unwrap();
            c.ready(&["A2"]);
            let next = a.wait().await.unwrap();
            assert!(!Arc::ptr_eq(&first, &next));
            assert!(next.claim_continuation().unwrap());
            r.show(b"C:A|").await.unwrap();
            next.finish_continuation();
            assert_eq!(out.get(), b"between|C:A|after|C:A|");
            p.once(2)
        } else {
            p.once(1)
        }
    }
    r.shutdown().await.unwrap();
}
async fn continuation_order() {
    let c = Controller::new();
    let p = Arc::new(Probe::default());
    let (r, out, _) = runtime(p.clone());
    let a = app(&r);
    let b = app(&r);
    child("A", "gate", b"A", b"", 0);
    a.run().unwrap();
    child("B", "gate", b"B", b"", 0);
    b.run().unwrap();
    let peers = c.ready(&["A", "B"]);
    c.release(&peers[1]);
    finalized(&p.last()).await;
    assert!(out.get().is_empty());
    c.release(&peers[0]);
    for (a, marker) in [(&a, b"C:A|"), (&b, b"C:B|")] {
        let i = a.wait().await.unwrap();
        assert!(i.claim_continuation().unwrap());
        r.show(marker).await.unwrap();
        i.finish_continuation()
    }
    assert_eq!(out.get(), b"C:A|C:B|");
    p.once(2);
    r.shutdown().await.unwrap();
}
async fn failure_continuations() {
    for mode in ["launch", "exit", "stop"] {
        let c = Controller::new();
        let p = Arc::new(Probe::default());
        let (r, out, _) = runtime(p.clone());
        let a = if mode == "launch" {
            r.app("companion/missing")
        } else {
            app(&r)
        };
        child(
            "A",
            if mode == "stop" { "gate" } else { "exit" },
            b"partial",
            b"detail",
            7,
        );
        a.run().unwrap();
        if mode != "launch" {
            let v = c.ready(&["A"]).remove(0);
            if mode == "stop" {
                a.stop().await.unwrap();
                c.stopped(&v)
            }
        }
        let i = a.wait().await.unwrap();
        assert!(a.error().unwrap().is_some());
        assert!(i.claim_continuation().unwrap());
        r.show(b"failed|").await.unwrap();
        i.finish_continuation();
        assert!(!a.wait().await.unwrap().claim_continuation().unwrap());
        assert_eq!(out.get(), b"failed|");
        r.shutdown().await.unwrap();
    }
}
async fn shutdown_case(id: &str) {
    let c = Controller::new();
    let p = Arc::new(Probe::default());
    let (r, _, _) = runtime(p.clone());
    let a = app(&r);
    child("A", "exit", b"finished", b"", 0);
    a.run().unwrap();
    c.ready(&["A"]);
    let old = p.last();
    finalized(&old).await;
    let b = app(&r);
    child("B", "gate", b"", b"", 0);
    b.run().unwrap();
    let peer = c.ready(&["B"]).remove(0);
    r.shutdown().await.unwrap();
    r.shutdown().await.unwrap();
    c.stopped(&peer);
    result(&old, b"finished", b"", 0);
    p.once(2);
    if id == "P1-RESULT-19" {
        let _ = app(&r).run();
        let refused = p.last();
        assert!(!Arc::ptr_eq(&old, &refused));
        finalized(&refused).await;
        assert!(refused.snapshot().unwrap().error.is_some());
        p.once(2)
    }
}
async fn launch_shutdown() {
    for boundary in [Checkpoint::PreStart, Checkpoint::SuccessfulStart] {
        let c = Controller::new();
        let p = Arc::new(Probe::default());
        let gate = Arc::new(Gate::default());
        let hold = gate.clone();
        *p.checkpoint_hook.lock().unwrap() = Some(Arc::new(move |e, _| {
            if e == boundary {
                hold.hit()
            }
        }));
        let (r, _, _) = runtime(p.clone());
        child("A", "gate", b"", b"", 0);
        let a = app(&r);
        let task = tokio::task::spawn_blocking(move || a.run());
        gate.observe();
        // Ownership/readiness is observed before shutdown may kill the child.
        let started_peer = if boundary == Checkpoint::SuccessfulStart {
            Some(c.ready(&["A"]).remove(0))
        } else {
            None
        };
        tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_secs(3), r.shutdown())
            .await
            .expect("shutdown while launch barrier held")
            .unwrap();
        gate.release();
        let _ = task.await.unwrap();
        if boundary == Checkpoint::PreStart {
            p.once(0)
        } else {
            c.stopped(started_peer.as_ref().unwrap());
            p.once(1)
        }
        finalized(&p.last()).await;
        assert!(p.last().snapshot().unwrap().error.is_some())
    }
}
async fn resources(id: &str) {
    let c = Controller::new();
    let p = Arc::new(Probe::default());
    let (r, _, _) = runtime(p.clone());
    if id == "P1-RESOURCE-02" {
        let mut apps = Vec::new();
        let labels: Vec<_> = (0..8).map(|n| n.to_string()).collect();
        for l in &labels {
            child(l, "gate", l.as_bytes(), b"", 0);
            let a = app(&r);
            a.run().unwrap();
            apps.push(a)
        }
        let peers = c.ready(&labels.iter().map(String::as_str).collect::<Vec<_>>());
        for n in (0..8).rev() {
            c.alive(&peers[n]);
            c.release(&peers[n]);
            result(&join(&apps[n]).await, labels[n].as_bytes(), b"", 0)
        }
        p.once(8)
    } else if id == "P1-RESOURCE-04" || id == "P1-RESOURCE-05" {
        child("A", "gate", b"A", b"", 0);
        let a = app(&r);
        a.run().unwrap();
        let peer = c.ready(&["A"]).remove(0);
        *p.start_fault.lock().unwrap() = Some(libc::EMFILE);
        let b = app(&r);
        b.run().unwrap();
        let failed = join(&b).await;
        assert!(errno(
            &failed.snapshot().unwrap().error.unwrap(),
            libc::EMFILE
        ));
        c.alive(&peer);
        *p.start_fault.lock().unwrap() = None;
        child("B", "exit", b"recovered", b"", 0);
        b.run().unwrap();
        c.ready(&["B"]);
        result(&join(&b).await, b"recovered", b"", 0);
        c.release(&peer);
        join(&a).await;
        assert_eq!(p.starts.load(Ordering::SeqCst), 3);
        assert_eq!(p.waits.load(Ordering::SeqCst), 2);
        assert_eq!(p.reaped.load(Ordering::SeqCst), 2)
    } else {
        let a = app(&r);
        let mut identities = Vec::new();
        let mut extra = 0;
        if id == "P1-RESOURCE-01" {
            child("stopped", "gate", b"", b"", 0);
            a.run().unwrap();
            let peer = c.ready(&["stopped"]).remove(0);
            a.stop().await.unwrap();
            identities.push(join(&a).await);
            c.stopped(&peer);
            extra = 1;
            let failed = r.app("companion/absent");
            failed.run().unwrap();
            identities.push(join(&failed).await)
        }
        let fd = || {
            std::fs::read_dir(if cfg!(target_os = "linux") {
                "/proc/self/fd"
            } else {
                "/dev/fd"
            })
            .unwrap()
            .count()
        };
        let initial = fd();
        for n in 0..64 {
            let payload = format!("token-{n}");
            child("A", "exit", payload.as_bytes(), b"", 0);
            a.run().unwrap();
            c.ready(&["A"]);
            let i = join(&a).await;
            assert!(identities.iter().all(|old| !Arc::ptr_eq(old, &i)));
            result(&i, payload.as_bytes(), b"", 0);
            identities.push(i)
        }
        p.once(64 + extra);
        if id == "P1-RESOURCE-03" {
            assert!(fd() <= initial + 3, "monotonically retained descriptors")
        }
    }
    r.shutdown().await.unwrap();
}
fn checkpoint(label: &str) {
    use std::io::{BufRead, BufReader};
    use std::os::unix::net::UnixStream;
    let mut s = UnixStream::connect(std::env::var_os("P1_SOCKET").unwrap()).unwrap();
    writeln!(
        s,
        "{{\"Label\":{},\"Record\":\"\",\"PID\":{},\"PPID\":{},\"PGID\":{}}}",
        crate::ownership::quote(label),
        std::process::id(),
        unsafe { libc::getppid() },
        unsafe { libc::getpgrp() }
    )
    .unwrap();
    let mut line = String::new();
    BufReader::new(s).read_line(&mut line).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(line, "release\n")
}
struct BrokenDiagnostic;
impl tokio::io::AsyncWrite for BrokenDiagnostic {
    fn poll_write(
        self: std::pin::Pin<&mut Self>,
        _: &mut std::task::Context<'_>,
        _: &[u8],
    ) -> std::task::Poll<io::Result<usize>> {
        writeln!(
            std::fs::OpenOptions::new()
                .create(true)
                .append(true)
                .open(std::env::var_os("P1_DIAGNOSTIC_LOG").unwrap())
                .unwrap(),
            "write"
        )
        .unwrap();
        std::task::Poll::Ready(Err(io::Error::from_raw_os_error(libc::EPIPE)))
    }
    fn poll_flush(
        self: std::pin::Pin<&mut Self>,
        _: &mut std::task::Context<'_>,
    ) -> std::task::Poll<io::Result<()>> {
        std::task::Poll::Ready(Ok(()))
    }
    fn poll_shutdown(
        self: std::pin::Pin<&mut Self>,
        _: &mut std::task::Context<'_>,
    ) -> std::task::Poll<io::Result<()>> {
        std::task::Poll::Ready(Ok(()))
    }
}
pub fn fault_main() {
    if let Ok(mode) = std::env::var("P1_SUPERVISION_FAULT") {
        supervision_main(&mode);
        return;
    }
    let executor = tokio::runtime::Builder::new_multi_thread()
        .worker_threads(4)
        .enable_all()
        .build()
        .unwrap();
    let code = executor.block_on(fault_source());
    std::process::exit(code as i32)
}
async fn fault_source() -> u8 {
    let mode = std::env::var("P1_FATAL_MODE").unwrap();
    let p = Arc::new(Probe::default());
    let stderr: hooks::Output = if mode == "count-broken-err" {
        Box::pin(BrokenDiagnostic)
    } else {
        Box::pin(tokio::io::stderr())
    };
    let r = hooks::new_observed(p.clone(), Box::pin(tokio::io::stdout()), stderr).unwrap();
    let a = app(&r);
    let b = app(&r);
    if mode == "cleanup-priority" || mode == "cleanup-failure" {
        let probe = p.clone();
        *p.signal_hook.lock().unwrap() = Some(Arc::new(move |target, s| {
            signal_os(target, s)?;
            let pid = match target {
                SignalTarget::Group(p) | SignalTarget::Leader(p) => p,
            };
            let n = probe
                .pids
                .lock()
                .unwrap()
                .iter()
                .position(|p| *p == pid)
                .unwrap();
            let text = Box::leak(format!("cleanup child {n}: permission denied").into_boxed_str());
            Err(io::Error::other(Fault(text)))
        }))
    }
    if mode.starts_with("compete-") {
        let seen = Arc::new(AtomicUsize::new(0));
        let once = seen.clone();
        let probe = p.clone();
        let fatal_first = mode == "compete-fatal-first";
        *p.signal_hook.lock().unwrap() = Some(Arc::new(move |target, s| {
            if once.fetch_add(1, Ordering::SeqCst) == 0 {
                // This observer deliberately blocks cleanup while an independent
                // runtime task observes the competing request. Hand the worker
                // back to Tokio so the observer cannot starve that task.
                tokio::task::block_in_place(|| {
                    checkpoint("orchestrator-first-decision");
                    let events = probe.terminal.lock().unwrap();
                    let (events, timeout) = probe
                        .terminal_cv
                        .wait_timeout_while(events, Duration::from_secs(4), |events| {
                            !events.iter().any(|e| {
                                if fatal_first {
                                    matches!(e, TerminalRequest::Signal(130 | 143))
                                } else {
                                    matches!(e, TerminalRequest::Failure)
                                }
                            })
                        })
                        .unwrap();
                    assert!(
                        !timeout.timed_out(),
                        "competing request never entered actual runtime: {events:?}"
                    );
                    drop(events);
                    checkpoint("orchestrator-competing-observed")
                });
            }
            signal_os(target, s)
        }));
        if !fatal_first {
            let rt = r.clone();
            tokio::spawn(async move {
                while seen.load(Ordering::SeqCst) == 0 {
                    tokio::task::yield_now().await
                }
                let _ = rt.fail(runtime::Error::new("requested failure"));
            });
        }
    }
    child("A", "gate", b"payload", b"", 0);
    a.run().unwrap();
    child("B", "descendant", b"payload", b"", 0);
    b.run().unwrap();
    checkpoint("orchestrator");
    if mode == "wait-watchdog" || mode == "wait-early" {
        r.shutdown().await.unwrap();
        checkpoint("orchestrator-wait-cleanup");
        panic!("fatal wait cleanup checkpoint unexpectedly released");
    }
    r.run(async {
        if mode == "completed-duplicate" || mode.starts_with("continuation-") {
            a.stop().await?;
            let i = a.wait().await?;
            if mode.starts_with("continuation-") {
                assert!(i.claim_continuation()?)
            } else {
                finalized(&i).await
            }
        }
        match mode.as_str() {
            "normal" | "cleanup-failure" => Ok(()),
            "bare" | "continuation-bare" => Err(r.exit()),
            "fail"
            | "continuation-fail"
            | "cleanup-priority"
            | "count-broken-err"
            | "compete-fatal-first" => Err(r.fail(runtime::Error::new("requested failure"))),
            "await-none" => {
                app(&r).wait().await?;
                panic!("source after no-invocation misuse")
            }
            "build-await" => {
                let unused = app(&r);
                unused.build()?;
                unused.wait().await?;
                panic!("source after Build/Await misuse")
            }
            "duplicate" | "completed-duplicate" | "continuation-rerun" => {
                a.run()?;
                panic!("source after duplicate Run")
            }
            "build-outstanding" => {
                a.build()?;
                panic!("source after outstanding Build")
            }
            "stop-none" => {
                app(&r).stop().await?;
                panic!("source after Stop misuse")
            }
            "output-none" => {
                app(&r).output()?;
                panic!("source after unavailable Output")
            }
            "output-running" => {
                a.output()?;
                panic!("source after running Output")
            }
            "broken-out" => {
                r.show(b"broken pipe").await?;
                panic!("broken stdout succeeded")
            }
            "broken-err" => Err(r.fail(runtime::Error::new("requested failure"))),
            "signal-await" | "compete-signal-first" => {
                a.wait().await?;
                panic!("unawaited continuation after signal")
            }
            "signal-before-await" => loop {
                r.check_source()?;
                tokio::task::yield_now().await
            },
            "nested-exit" => {
                a.stop().await?;
                let i = a.wait().await?;
                assert!(i.claim_continuation()?);
                child("C", "gate", b"", b"", 0);
                let c = app(&r);
                c.run()?;
                checkpoint("orchestrator-nested");
                Err(r.exit())
            }
            "panic" => panic!("intentional Rust source panic"),
            _ => panic!("unregistered fatal mode {mode}"),
        }
    })
    .await
}
async fn fatal(mode: &str, signal: Option<Signal>) {
    use std::io::Read;
    use std::process::{Command, Stdio};
    let c = Controller::new();
    let root = std::env::current_exe()
        .unwrap()
        .parent()
        .unwrap()
        .to_path_buf();
    let log = c.dir.join("waits");
    let diaglog = c.dir.join("diagnostics");
    let mut cmd = Command::new(root.join("runtime-fault"));
    cmd.env("P1_FATAL_MODE", mode)
        .env("P1_WAITLOG", &log)
        .env("P1_DIAGNOSTIC_LOG", &diaglog)
        .stdout(Stdio::piped())
        .stderr(Stdio::piped());
    let mut owner = FatalWaitOwner {
        child: cmd.spawn().unwrap(),
        reaped: false,
    };
    let mut stdout = owner.child.stdout.take();
    let mut stderr = owner.child.stderr.take();
    if mode == "broken-out" {
        drop(stdout.take())
    }
    if mode == "broken-err" {
        drop(stderr.take())
    }
    let out = std::thread::spawn(move || {
        let mut b = Vec::new();
        if let Some(mut pipe) = stdout {
            pipe.read_to_end(&mut b).unwrap();
        }
        b
    });
    let err = std::thread::spawn(move || {
        let mut b = Vec::new();
        if let Some(mut pipe) = stderr {
            pipe.read_to_end(&mut b).unwrap();
        }
        b
    });
    let peers = c.ready(&["A", "B", "B.child", "orchestrator"]);
    for p in &peers[..3] {
        c.alive(p)
    }
    if let Ok(pid_path) = std::env::var("P1_FATAL_CONTROLLER_FAULT") {
        // Isolate direct-child ownership from application cleanup. Every App
        // helper's recorded lifetime has ended before this injected panic.
        for p in &peers[..3] {
            c.release(p);
        }
        for p in &peers[..3] {
            c.stopped(p);
        }
        std::fs::write(pid_path, owner.child.id().to_string()).unwrap();
        panic!("intentional fatal controller failure before checkpoint release");
    }
    if mode == "signal-before-await" || mode == "signal-await" || mode == "compete-signal-first" {
        kill(Pid::from_raw(owner.child.id() as i32), signal.unwrap()).unwrap()
    }
    c.release(&peers[3]);
    if mode.starts_with("compete-") {
        let first = c.ready(&["orchestrator-first-decision"]).remove(0);
        if mode == "compete-fatal-first" {
            kill(Pid::from_raw(owner.child.id() as i32), signal.unwrap()).unwrap()
        }
        c.release(&first);
        let observed = c.ready(&["orchestrator-competing-observed"]).remove(0);
        c.release(&observed)
    }
    let mut nested = None;
    if mode == "nested-exit" {
        let values = c.ready(&["C", "orchestrator-nested"]);
        c.release(&values[1]);
        nested = Some(values[0].clone())
    }
    let end = std::time::Instant::now() + Duration::from_secs(6);
    let status = loop {
        if let Some(s) = owner.child.try_wait().unwrap() {
            owner.reaped = true;
            break s;
        }
        if std::time::Instant::now() > end {
            panic!("fatal runtime subprocess watchdog")
        }
        std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(1))
    };
    let output = out.join().unwrap();
    let diagnostics = err.join().unwrap();
    assert!(
        output.is_empty(),
        "unexpected source/harness stdout {output:?}"
    );
    let expected = if mode == "panic" {
        101
    } else if mode == "compete-fatal-first" {
        1
    } else if mode.starts_with("signal-") || mode == "compete-signal-first" {
        match signal.unwrap() {
            Signal::SIGINT => 130,
            Signal::SIGTERM => 143,
            _ => unreachable!(),
        }
    } else if ["normal", "bare", "continuation-bare", "nested-exit"].contains(&mode) {
        0
    } else {
        1
    };
    assert_eq!(
        status.code(),
        Some(expected),
        "mode {mode}, stderr {}",
        String::from_utf8_lossy(&diagnostics)
    );
    for p in &peers[..3] {
        c.stopped(p)
    }
    if let Some(p) = nested {
        c.stopped(&p)
    }
    let waits = std::fs::read_to_string(log).unwrap();
    let ids: Vec<_> = waits.lines().collect();
    assert_eq!(ids.len(), if mode == "nested-exit" { 3 } else { 2 });
    let unique: std::collections::BTreeSet<_> = ids.iter().collect();
    assert_eq!(unique.len(), ids.len(), "duplicate direct-child Wait");
    for p in &peers[..2] {
        assert!(ids.contains(&p.pid.to_string().as_str()))
    }
    if ["fail", "continuation-fail", "compete-fatal-first"].contains(&mode) {
        assert_eq!(diagnostics, b"requested failure\n")
    }
    if mode == "count-broken-err" {
        assert_eq!(std::fs::read(diaglog).unwrap(), b"write\n");
        assert!(diagnostics.is_empty())
    }
    if mode == "cleanup-priority" {
        assert_eq!(diagnostics,b"requested failure\nterminate application process group: cleanup child 0: permission denied\nterminate application process group: cleanup child 1: permission denied\n")
    }
    if mode == "cleanup-failure" {
        let text = String::from_utf8(diagnostics.clone()).unwrap();
        let a = text.find("cleanup child 0").unwrap();
        let b = text.find("cleanup child 1").unwrap();
        assert!(a < b);
        assert_eq!(text.matches("cleanup child 0").count(), 1);
        assert_eq!(text.matches("cleanup child 1").count(), 1)
    }
    if mode == "panic" {
        assert!(String::from_utf8_lossy(&diagnostics).contains("intentional Rust source panic"))
    }
    if ["output-none", "output-running"].contains(&mode) {
        assert!(String::from_utf8_lossy(&diagnostics).contains("Output is unavailable"))
    } else if [
        "await-none",
        "build-await",
        "duplicate",
        "completed-duplicate",
        "continuation-rerun",
        "build-outstanding",
        "stop-none",
    ]
    .contains(&mode)
    {
        assert!(String::from_utf8_lossy(&diagnostics).contains("invocation"))
    }
}
async fn failed_exit() {
    let c = Controller::new();
    let p = Arc::new(Probe::default());
    let (r, out, err) = runtime(p.clone());
    let a = app(&r);
    child("A", "exit", b"partial\n", b"details\n", 7);
    a.run().unwrap();
    c.ready(&["A"]);
    let i = join(&a).await;
    result(&i, b"partial\n", b"details\n", 7);
    r.show(&a.output().unwrap()).await.unwrap();
    let status = r.finish(Err(a.error().unwrap().unwrap())).await;
    assert_eq!(status, 1);
    assert_eq!(out.get(), b"partial\n");
    assert!(String::from_utf8_lossy(&err.get()).contains("details"));
    p.once(1)
}
async fn dispatch(id: &str) {
    match id {
        "P1-RUN-01" | "P1-RUN-05" | "P1-RUN-06" | "P1-RUN-07" | "P1-RUN-08" | "P1-RUN-09"
        | "P1-RUN-10" | "P1-RUN-11" | "P1-RUN-14" => launch(id).await,
        "P1-RUN-02" | "P1-RUN-03" | "P1-RUN-04" | "P1-AWAIT-10" => overlap(id).await,
        "P1-AWAIT-01" => pending().await,
        "P1-AWAIT-02" | "P1-AWAIT-03" | "P1-AWAIT-04" | "P1-AWAIT-08" | "P1-AWAIT-17"
        | "P1-RESULT-10" => cached(id).await,
        "P1-AWAIT-05" => fatal("await-none", None).await,
        "P1-AWAIT-06" => fatal("build-await", None).await,
        "P1-AWAIT-07" | "P1-RESULT-12" | "P1-RESULT-16" => failed_launch(id).await,
        "P1-AWAIT-09" | "P1-STOP-01" | "P1-STOP-02" | "P1-STOP-03" | "P1-STOP-09"
        | "P1-STOP-10" | "P1-STOP-11" | "P1-STOP-12" | "P1-STOP-13" | "P1-STOP-15"
        | "P1-STOP-16" => stopped(id).await,
        "P1-AWAIT-11" => fatal("duplicate", None).await,
        "P1-AWAIT-12" => fatal("completed-duplicate", None).await,
        "P1-AWAIT-13" | "P1-AWAIT-14" | "P1-RESULT-11" => rerun(id).await,
        "P1-AWAIT-15" => stale_stop().await,
        "P1-AWAIT-16" => fatal("continuation-rerun", None).await,
        "P1-AWAIT-18" => concurrent().await,
        "P1-STOP-04" => fatal("stop-none", None).await,
        "P1-STOP-05" | "P1-STOP-06" => stop_completed(id).await,
        "P1-STOP-07" | "P1-STOP-14" => publication(id).await,
        "P1-STOP-08" => stop_stress().await,
        "P1-RESULT-01" | "P1-RESULT-02" | "P1-RESULT-03" | "P1-RESULT-04" | "P1-RESULT-07" => {
            raw_result(id).await
        }
        "P1-RESULT-05" | "P1-RESULT-20" => capture(id).await,
        "P1-RESULT-06" => failed_exit().await,
        "P1-RESULT-08" => fatal("output-none", None).await,
        "P1-RESULT-09" => fatal("output-running", None).await,
        "P1-RESULT-13" | "P1-RESULT-15" | "P1-RESULT-17" | "P1-RESULT-22" => readiness(id).await,
        "P1-RESULT-14" => invalid_companion().await,
        "P1-RESULT-18" => fatal("build-outstanding", None).await,
        "P1-RESULT-19" => shutdown_case(id).await,
        "P1-CONT-01" | "P1-CONT-02" | "P1-CONT-03" | "P1-CONT-08" | "P1-CONT-09" | "P1-CONT-10"
        | "P1-CONT-11" => continuations(id).await,
        "P1-CONT-04" => continuation_order().await,
        "P1-CONT-05" => failure_continuations().await,
        "P1-CONT-06" => fatal("continuation-bare", None).await,
        "P1-CONT-07" => fatal("continuation-fail", None).await,
        "P1-EXIT-01" => fatal("normal", None).await,
        "P1-EXIT-02" => fatal("bare", None).await,
        "P1-EXIT-03" | "P1-EXIT-15" => fatal("fail", None).await,
        "P1-EXIT-04" => fatal("output-none", None).await,
        "P1-EXIT-05" => {
            for mode in ["broken-out", "broken-err", "count-broken-err"] {
                fatal(mode, None).await
            }
        }
        "P1-EXIT-06" => fatal("signal-await", Some(Signal::SIGINT)).await,
        "P1-EXIT-07" => fatal("signal-await", Some(Signal::SIGTERM)).await,
        "P1-EXIT-08" => {
            for s in [Signal::SIGINT, Signal::SIGTERM] {
                fatal("signal-before-await", Some(s)).await
            }
        }
        "P1-EXIT-09" => launch_shutdown().await,
        "P1-EXIT-10" => shutdown_case(id).await,
        "P1-EXIT-11" => {
            for s in [Signal::SIGINT, Signal::SIGTERM] {
                for mode in ["compete-signal-first", "compete-fatal-first"] {
                    fatal(mode, Some(s)).await
                }
            }
        }
        "P1-EXIT-12" => fatal("cleanup-priority", None).await,
        "P1-EXIT-13" => fatal("cleanup-failure", None).await,
        "P1-EXIT-14" => fatal("nested-exit", None).await,
        "P1-RESOURCE-01" | "P1-RESOURCE-02" | "P1-RESOURCE-03" | "P1-RESOURCE-04"
        | "P1-RESOURCE-05" => resources(id).await,
        _ => panic!("unregistered Rust runtime ID {id}"),
    }
}
#[test]
fn driver() {
    let id = std::env::var("P1_CASE").expect("outer case registry ID");
    let executor = tokio::runtime::Builder::new_multi_thread()
        .worker_threads(4)
        .enable_all()
        .build()
        .unwrap();
    executor.block_on(dispatch(&id));
    println!("RUST-PARITY-PASS {id}")
}

fn registered(count: usize) {
    let until = std::time::Instant::now() + Duration::from_secs(4);
    loop {
        let count_now = std::fs::read_dir(std::env::var_os("P1_OWNERSHIP").unwrap())
            .unwrap()
            .filter_map(Result::ok)
            .filter(|e| e.file_name().to_string_lossy().starts_with("alive-"))
            .filter(|e| std::fs::read_to_string(e.path()).is_ok_and(|s| s.contains("\"PID\":")))
            .count();
        if count_now == count {
            return;
        }
        assert!(
            std::time::Instant::now() < until,
            "ownership registration missing: {count_now}/{count}"
        );
        std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(1))
    }
}
fn armed() {
    std::io::stdout().write_all(b"out\0\n").unwrap();
    std::io::stdout().flush().unwrap();
    std::io::stderr().write_all(b"err\0\n").unwrap();
    std::io::stderr().flush().unwrap();
    std::fs::write(std::env::var_os("P1_SUPERVISION_ARMED").unwrap(), b"").unwrap()
}
fn supervision_main(mode: &str) {
    if mode == "nested" {
        let mut child = std::process::Command::new(std::env::current_exe().unwrap());
        child
            .env("P1_SUPERVISION_FAULT", "nested-child")
            .stdout(std::process::Stdio::null())
            .stderr(std::process::Stdio::null());
        child.spawn().unwrap();
        registered(3);
        armed();
        std::process::exit(23)
    }
    let executor = tokio::runtime::Builder::new_multi_thread()
        .worker_threads(4)
        .enable_all()
        .build()
        .unwrap();
    executor.block_on(async {
        if mode == "nested-child" {
            let Some((_held, _)) = crate::ownership::register("nested-driver").unwrap() else {
                return;
            };
            let _c = Controller::new();
            let p = Arc::new(Probe::default());
            let (r, _, _) = runtime(p);
            child("A", "descendant", b"", b"", 0);
            app(&r).run().unwrap();
            loop {
                std::thread::park()
            }
        }
        let p = Arc::new(Probe::default());
        let owned = mode.to_owned();
        let ready = PathBuf::from(std::env::var_os("P1_SUPERVISION_ARMED").unwrap())
            .with_extension("never-ready");
        let gate = ready.clone();
        *p.start_hook.lock().unwrap() = Some(Arc::new(move |cmd| {
            let child = cmd.spawn()?;
            registered(1);
            assert!(!gate.exists());
            armed();
            match owned.as_str() {
                "rust-panic" => panic!("intentional Rust supervision panic"),
                "abrupt-start" => std::process::exit(23),
                "outer-timeout" => loop {
                    std::thread::park()
                },
                _ => panic!("unknown supervision mode"),
            };
            #[allow(unreachable_code)]
            Ok(child)
        }));
        let (r, _, _) = runtime(p);
        child("A", "gate", b"", b"", 0);
        env("P1_READYFILE", ready);
        app(&r).run().unwrap();
        panic!("blocked Start unexpectedly returned")
    });
}
struct FatalWaitOwner {
    child: std::process::Child,
    reaped: bool,
}
impl Drop for FatalWaitOwner {
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        if !self.reaped {
            let _ = self.child.kill();
            let _ = self.child.wait();
            self.reaped = true;
            println!("fatal child cleanup reaped once");
        }
    }
}
#[test]
fn fatal_controller_cleanup() {
    use nix::errno::Errno;
    use nix::sys::wait::{WaitPidFlag, WaitStatus, waitpid};
    let pid_path = std::env::var("P1_FATAL_CONTROLLER_FAULT").unwrap();
    let executor = tokio::runtime::Builder::new_multi_thread()
        .worker_threads(4)
        .enable_all()
        .build()
        .unwrap();
    let failure = std::panic::catch_unwind(std::panic::AssertUnwindSafe(|| {
        executor.block_on(fatal("normal", None));
    }));
    assert!(failure.is_err(), "injected controller failure disappeared");
    let pid = Pid::from_raw(std::fs::read_to_string(pid_path).unwrap().parse().unwrap());
    // Only the controller's successful OS Wait can make its known direct child
    // unavailable here. A completed-but-unreaped child is also a regression.
    let already_reaped = match waitpid(pid, Some(WaitPidFlag::WNOHANG)) {
        Err(Errno::ECHILD) => true,
        Ok(WaitStatus::StillAlive) => {
            kill(pid, Signal::SIGKILL).unwrap();
            waitpid(pid, None).unwrap();
            false
        }
        Ok(_) => false,
        Err(error) => panic!("inspect direct child ownership: {error}"),
    };
    assert!(already_reaped, "fatal controller did not reap its direct child on unwind");
    println!("fatal controller direct child already reaped after failure");
}
#[test]
fn fatal_wait_fault() {
    let mode = std::env::var("P1_FATAL_WAIT_FAULT").unwrap();
    assert!(mode == "wait-watchdog" || mode == "wait-early");
    let c = Controller::new();
    let exe = std::env::current_exe()
        .unwrap()
        .parent()
        .unwrap()
        .join("runtime-fault");
    let proc = std::process::Command::new(exe)
        .env("P1_FATAL_MODE", &mode)
        .stdout(std::process::Stdio::null())
        .stderr(std::process::Stdio::null())
        .spawn()
        .unwrap();
    let mut owner = FatalWaitOwner {
        child: proc,
        reaped: false,
    };
    let peers = c.ready(&["A", "B", "B.child", "orchestrator"]);
    c.release(&peers[3]);
    let _held = c.ready(&["orchestrator-wait-cleanup"]);
    for p in &peers[..3] {
        c.stopped(p)
    }
    println!("fatal wait fault armed: {mode}");
    if mode == "wait-early" {
        panic!("intentional failure before fatal wait selection")
    };
    let until = std::time::Instant::now() + Duration::from_millis(150);
    while std::time::Instant::now() < until {
        assert!(
            owner.child.try_wait().unwrap().is_none(),
            "fatal child exited before fault watchdog"
        );
        std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(1))
    }
    panic!("fatal-path watchdog: orchestrator did not exit")
}
